```python
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
import base64
```
```python
    endpoint = config.get("endpoint") or os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY")
    model_id = config.get("model_id", "prebuilt-document")
    required_fields = config.get("required_fields", [])
    min_confidence = config.get("min_confidence", 0.5)

    credential = AzureKeyCredential(api_key)
    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=credential)

    document_bytes = base64.b64decode(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload

    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(model_id, document_bytes)
    analyze_result = poller.result()

    if not analyze_result.documents:
        raise ValueError("No documents found in analysis result")

    doc = analyze_result.documents[0]
    field_dict = {field.name: field for field in doc.fields}

    validation = {}
    for req in required_fields:
        field_name = req["name"]
        req_conf = req.get("min_confidence", min_confidence)
        if field_name in field_dict:
            confidence = field_dict[field_name].confidence
            valid = confidence >= req_conf
            validation[field_name] = {
                "present": True,
                "confidence": confidence,
                "valid": valid,
                "value": field_dict[field_name].content
            }
        else:
            validation[field_name] = {
                "present": False,
                "valid": False
            }
```
